licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These 13 buckets cover the full distribution by separating the dominant legal/conceptual clusters: fraud in obtaining licensure versus fraud in practice, criminal history, clinical negligence, substance misuse, non-substance physical/mental unfitness, broad unprofessional conduct, controlled-substance prescribing specifics, false advertising, fee-splitting/billing/exploitation, aiding unlicensed persons, scope-of-practice overreach, and out-of-state disciplinary reciprocity, which together account for nearly every item with no meaningful remainder.

profession_specific.board_certification_.rationale: The items cluster into four named-board categories (ABFAS, the legacy ABPS/podiatric-surgery boards, ABPM) plus a CPME umbrella reference, with a residual bucket covering vague 'nationally recognized' or state-approved formulations.
